items.summary: MoE path unsupported on AMD; fp16/bf16 and cublasLt-int8 Linear are supported.

ZhiLight HIP port gated off the NVIDIA tensor-core / Hopper-only fast paths: Marlin/AWQ/FP8/GPTQ quant kernels (mma.sync, ldmatrix, cp.async, cvt.e4m3x2, prmt.b32, lop3, __vsub4), WMMA attention decode, int8-quantized-KV attention, deep_gemm FP8-block + flash_mla MLA H20 static libs (DeepSeek-V3 FP8-block + MLA), flash-attn prefill, and GPTQ/AWQ/Marlin/fp8 quantized MoE. These throw a clear error or fall back on HIP; reimplement-not-port for AMD (MFMA/WMMA, hipBLASLt FP8) to fully finish the port.

ZhiLight Windows ROCm build blocked: bundled bmengine host runtime uses Linux-only POSIX APIs (execinfo.h, sched.h, pthread.h, sys/syscall.h, sys/time.h) with no _WIN32 guards. GPU kernel TUs compile for gfx1101/gfx1201, but the host infra needs a Windows-compat layer. Resume to add Windows support to the port.
